info.title: CueFinder Sync Discovery API
info.description: Sync-discovery engine for the Cumulative Web Inc catalog. Describe a scene, mood, or brief in plain language and resolve licensable track matches from the 24-track sync catalog with sonic descriptors. Public read-only HTTPS GET. No authentication required. Rights: no one-stop or pre-cleared claims; direct clearance via hp@cumulativeweb.com.

get.description: 24-track sync catalog with sonic descriptors (mood, energy, BPM, scene use-cases).
